name: Acme Public Bug Bounty Submission
summary: Two issues found on in-scope assets while following the program rules. No customer data was accessed beyond the researcher's own test accounts, and testing was stopped as soon as each issue was confirmed.

scope.rules_of_engagement: No denial-of-service. Business hours only. No real customer data.

findings.title: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR)
findings.description: PUT /api/profile/{id} updates the profile of the id in the URL without checking ownership.
findings.impact: A user can change another user's name and e-mail address, which can lead to account takeover through password reset.
findings.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Create two test accounts, A and B.

2. As A, send PUT /api/profile/<B's id> with a new display name.

3. Sign in as B and observe the changed name.
findings.remediation: Verify on the server that the id in the URL matches the signed-in user, or ignore the id and use the session.

findings.title: Open redirect
findings.description: The next parameter of /login redirects to any URL after sign-in.
findings.impact: Attackers can send victims a trusted-looking login link that lands on a malicious page.
findings.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open https://app.acme.test/login?next=https://example.org.

2. Sign in with a test account.

3. The browser is redirected to https://example.org.
findings.remediation: Redirect only to an allow-list of known destinations or to relative paths.
